correctness.rationale: Using characteristic-three quadratic discriminant, U indicator is (1+chi(x²-4y)+1_{x²=4y})/2, and the missing vertical portion has (q-1)/2 points. Gauss identities with chi(-1)=-1 imply G=±i√q, yielding the exact complex transform for b≠0 and (q-1)/2 for b=0,a≠0. For z=a²/b, three trace values and trace-fiber character sums produce the four levels and counts (q-1), q(q-1)/3, (q-1)(q/3±3^((m-1)/2)); these sum to q²-1. An independently coded GF(27) union-of-lines transform checked all 728 nonzero frequencies, with levels 26,234,312,156; source CHECK.py was inspected. Infinite odd m follows from Gauss/trace proof rather than q=27 testing. Assumptions q=3^m, odd m≥3, uniform measure and specified Fourier normalization all respected.
